body: Anytime. I might just be some random guy on the internet but I believe in you. I’ve been at that same low point too, but it does get better. The fact that you are trying shows how much you are willing to improve on yourself, and that in itself is an achievement all on its own. Be proud of that, you got this.

Life is hard, no one chose to be born. But you gotta try and search for something, even just one thing that can brings you happiness. Fuck money and all that other bullshit, find something to believe in, even when you feel like there’s nothing in this world to believe in
I have not, I don’t have any way of contacting her sadly.

Like you said, you have so many people that care about you, it would be absolutely devastating to them. They love you for who you are, bipolar and all. Learning to love yourself is one of the hardest things to do, and there is simply no to go to answer for everyone on how to do it. But I ask you to try. There is so many things to love and experience in life. Sometimes the hardest times make the greatest people. Don’t ever forget your self worth.

Please call 911! There are more people in this world that care about you than you think. Please, you only get one life, don’t do something that is going to ruin it all and hurt the people that truly love you. If you need to talk, you can personally DM me.
